# IoT Core

Connect devices and manage registry, policies, rules, jobs, provisioning, and fleet searches.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `iot` |
| Signing name | `iot` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2015-05-28` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | MQTT broker / local APIs |
| Selected operations | 103 of 272 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#iot-core) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- HTTP rule actions and topic rule destinations remain deferred.
- Custom authorizer refreshAfterInSeconds is not acted on.
- No billing/dynamic groups, certificate transfers, CA auto-registration, continuous jobs or job rollout/retry/scheduling settings.
- Fleet SearchIndex scans local records; no aggregations, Device Defender or geolocation.
- MQTT session/in-flight state stays in memory; retained messages persist.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
